hero.label: Made for Fieldguide
hero.headline: I want to help Fieldguide own the audit AI category.
hero.subheadline: Fieldguide is doing something rare: building vertical AI that actually changes how an entire profession works, not just wraps a chatbot around it. The $200 billion audit and advisory market is underserved and ripe for what Jin and the team are building. I want to be the BDR who helps the right CPA firms find out Fieldguide exists.

whyCompany.title: Vertical AI for audit is a category-creation moment, not a feature war
whyCompany.body: Fieldguide is not competing on price inside a crowded horizontal SaaS category. It is digitizing the entire end-to-end engagement workflow for assurance firms, from SOC to ESG to financial audit, on one platform. That kind of singular focus makes it far easier to sell because the value proposition is clear and the alternatives are paper and spreadsheets.

whyCompany.title: Series B, Y Combinator-backed, and still hiring early BDR talent
whyCompany.body: Fieldguide has the funding credibility and institutional backing to scale, but the BDR seat is still early enough to matter and to grow with the company. Being one of the first reps to build outbound motion in a newly funded vertical AI startup is the kind of opportunity that shapes a career. That timing is exactly what I am looking for.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and B2B digital marketing reps map directly to this pipeline motion
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach sequences in HubSpot and LinkedIn that helped close 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch, so I know what early-stage pipeline building actually feels like. At NextAfter I worked inside a B2B consultancy, which taught me how firms buy and how to speak the language of decision-makers who are skeptical of new tools. Both experiences point straight at what a Fieldguide BDR needs to do.

quote: Jin left the audit industry burnt out and decided to fix it instead of just complaining about it. I want to be the person who gets the next great CPA firm on the phone and makes sure they know that fix exists.
